question: Can IndexedDB hold an atomic generation pointer and a compare-and-swap canonical ref?
meaning: an aborted multi-key IndexedDB transaction leaves the generation pointer untouched, and two concurrent compare-and-swap transactions from base g1 produce exactly one winner: IndexedDB can hold an atomic active/previous generation pointer and a base-unmoved ref update (the browser analogue of git update-ref <new> <old>)
